mapper.sql: s.id, s.area_id, a.parking_lot_id, a.area_code, s.space_code, s.description, s.status, s.created_at, s.updated_at
FROM parking_space s JOIN parking_area a ON a.id = s.area_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO parking_space (area_id, space_code, description, status) VALUES (#{areaId}, #{spaceCode}, #{description}, 'FREE')
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE a.parking_lot_id = #{lotId} AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.status = 'FREE' ORDER BY a.area_code, s.space_code, s.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF s
mapper.update: UPDATE parking_space SET status = 'OCCUPIED', updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'FREE'
